quote: Don't walk behind me; I may not lead. Don't walk in front of me; I may not follow. Just walk beside me and be my friend.
concern: Not found in Camus's writing; widely listed as misattributed

quote: Two things are infinite: the universe and human stupidity. And I'm not sure about the universe.
concern: No source in Einstein's papers; first credited to him second-hand in 1969

quote: Creativity is contagious. Pass it on.
Creativity is intelligence having fun.
The secret to creativity is knowing how to hide your sources.
concern: No known source; earlier versions credited to others

quote: The measure of intelligence is the ability to change.
In the middle of every difficulty lies opportunity.
Logic will get you from A to B. Imagination will take you everywhere.
You are braver than you believe, stronger than you seem, and smarter than you think.
concern: Not in Milne's books; written for the Disney film Pooh's Grand Adventure (1997)

quote: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
concern: These are Will Durant's words summarising Aristotle (The Story of Philosophy 1926)

quote: It is the mark of an educated mind to be able to entertain a thought without accepting it.
concern: Not in Aristotle; a modern paraphrase

quote: Knowing yourself is the beginning of all wisdom.
Tell me and I forget. Teach me and I remember. Involve me and I learn.
concern: Not Franklin; loosely adapted from the Chinese philosopher Xunzi

quote: Invest in yourself. It pays the best interest.
To keep the body in good health is a duty. Otherwise we shall not be able to keep our mind strong and clear.
You yourself, as much as anybody in the entire universe, deserve your love and affection.
concern: Sharon Salzberg's wording (Lovingkindness 1995) not the Buddha's

quote: You are never too old to set another goal or to dream a new dream.
You cannot go back and change the beginning, but you can start where you are and change the ending.
concern: Not Lewis; usually traced to James R. Sherman

quote: I am not what happened to me. I am what I choose to become.
concern: A modern paraphrase; not Jung's words

quote: The man who moves a mountain begins by carrying away small stones.
The man who asks a question is a fool for a minute. The man who does not ask is a fool for life.
It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
By three methods we may learn wisdom: first, by reflection, which is noblest; second, by imitation, which is easiest; and third, by experience, which is the bitterest.
Everything has beauty, but not everyone can see it.
One small positive thought in the morning can change your whole day.
Sleep is the best meditation.
Choose to be optimistic. It feels better.
Happiness is the highest form of health.
You know you're in love when you can't fall asleep because reality is finally better than your dreams.
concern: Not in any Dr. Seuss book

quote: Do one thing every day that scares you.
No one can make you feel inferior without your consent.
concern: Never found in her writing or speeches

quote: The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
Work hard in silence. Let success be your noise.
concern: Not Frank Ocean; anonymous internet saying

quote: If you get tired, learn to rest, not to quit.
Life isn't about finding yourself. Life is about creating yourself.
Whatever you can do or dream you can, begin it. Boldness has genius and power and magic in it.
concern: A loose 1835 rendering by John Anster; not in Goethe

quote: The world breaks everyone, and afterward, some are strong at the broken places.
concern: Real (A Farewell to Arms) but misquoted
suggested_text_change: The world breaks every one and afterward many are strong at the broken places.

quote: Let food be thy medicine and medicine be thy food.
A dream you dream alone is only a dream. A dream you dream together is reality.
Count your age by friends, not years. Count your life by smiles, not tears.
If you are depressed you are living in the past. If you are anxious you are living in the future. If you are at peace you are living in the present.
concern: Not in the Tao Te Ching; a modern saying

quote: Being deeply loved by someone gives you strength, while loving someone deeply gives you courage.
concern: Not in the Tao Te Ching

quote: Be the change you wish to see in the world.
concern: A popular paraphrase; Gandhi never wrote it in these words

quote: The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
Never regret anything that made you smile.
You don't have to see the whole staircase, just take the first step.
concern: No record in his speeches or writing

quote: It always seems impossible until it is done.
concern: No record in his speeches or writing

quote: Be yourself. Everyone else is already taken.
Always borrow money from a pessimist. They'll never expect it back.
Learn the rules like a pro so you can break them like an artist.
What lies behind us and what lies before us are tiny matters compared to what lies within us.
concern: Henry S. Haskins (Meditations in Wall Street 1940)

quote: The only person you are destined to become is the person you decide to be.
For every minute you are angry you lose sixty seconds of happiness.
Dare to live the life you have dreamed for yourself.
The only way out is through.
concern: Real but misquoted (A Servant to Servants 1915)
suggested_text_change: The best way out is always through.

quote: You are not a drop in the ocean. You are the entire ocean in a drop.
concern: No matching passage in Rumi; modern wording

quote: Yesterday I was clever, so I wanted to change the world. Today I am wise, so I am changing myself.
The secret of change is to focus all of your energy not on fighting the old, but on building the new.
concern: Said by the character Socrates in Dan Millman's novel Way of the Peaceful Warrior (1980)

quote: Believe you can and you're halfway there.
I find that the harder I work, the more luck I seem to have.
concern: Not Jefferson; earliest versions are 20th century

quote: If you want something you've never had, you must be willing to do something you've never done.
Even the darkest night will end and the sun will rise.
A fool thinks himself to be wise, but a wise man knows himself to be a fool.
concern: Real (As You Like It) but misquoted
suggested_text_change: The fool doth think he is wise, but the wise man knows himself to be a fool.

quote: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
Success is walking from failure to failure with no loss of enthusiasm.
If you're going through hell, keep going.
concern: No record of Churchill saying it

quote: Be happy for this moment. This moment is your life.
concern: No matching verse in the Rubaiyat

quote: It is easier to build strong children than to repair broken men.
concern: No record in Douglass's writing or speeches

quote: The people who are crazy enough to think they can change the world are the ones who do.
concern: From Apple's 1997 Think Different advert copy written by its agency

quote: All our dreams can come true, if we have the courage to pursue them.
concern: No record of Disney saying it

quote: A single act of kindness throws out roots in all directions.
Go confidently in the direction of your dreams. Live the life you have imagined.
concern: A paraphrase of a longer sentence in Walden
suggested_text_change: If one advances confidently in the direction of his dreams, and endeavors to live the life which he has imagined, he will meet with a success unexpected in common hours.

quote: Success usually comes to those who are too busy to be looking for it.
